Why Choose IES Abroad for Your Study Abroad Journey?

There is a version of you that you haven’t met yet—one who learns to navigate a new subway, speaks another language, and sees the world a bit differently. For 75+ years, we’ve helped over 190,000 students find that side of themselves across 30+ cities with more than 140 programs. Moving to a new country is a major milestone, and we make sure you’re supported every step of the way. From housing and health insurance to local staff who actually live in your host city, we take care of the logistics so you can simply focus on the experience.

See Our Commitment to You

“As I reflect on my journey, I realize that studying abroad was more than just an academic adventure; it was a transformative experience that shaped who I am today...If you’re contemplating studying abroad, know that the journey will be as much about discovering yourself as it is about exploring new places. Embrace the adventure, and you might find that the greatest growth happens when you step beyond the boundaries of your comfort zone.”

"From Map Pins to Milestones: My Journey of Growth While Studying Abroad"—
Howell P. ( Furman University | IES Abroad Santiago )

International Internships with IES Abroad

If you want to take your experience a step further, an international internship bridges the gap between the classroom and the global workforce. We work with you to secure a guaranteed professional placement in your field, complete with the academic credit you need to stay on track. This is your chance to build a global network and gain the kind of practical experience that sets your resume apart. Just like our study abroad programs, your housing, insurance, and on-the-ground support are completely handled. It is the perfect foundation to help you stand out and succeed in a global market.

Explore Internships & How It Works

“I learned that working in a global company with international offices and clients contributes to your personal and professional growth...This experience will enrich my resume as hiring managers will see my extensive experience in a global office and having directed a self-project that improved the company’s hiring process...”

From "Reflecting on My Summer Internship in London"—
Mia S. (University of North Carolina-Chapel Hill | IES Abroad London-Summer Internship )

Your Adventure, Fully Supported

See All Our Offerings

Priced for quality

One fee covers everything: tuition, housing, insurance, and full on-site support.

Fully supported 24/7

Trusted local staff ready to help with visas, health, housing, and safety, whenever you need them.

Credits that count toward your degree

Expert-led learning beyond the classroom, designed with university partners to count toward your degree.

Impactful with real career benefits

65% of alumni say studying abroad shaped their career and 64% say it led to career advancement.

$7.9 million in financial aid awarded annually

Need-based aid available for students at consortium universities.

How Does IES Abroad Support Students Before and During Their Programs?

APPLY FOR SCHOLARSHIPS

$7.9 Million in Scholarships & Aid

We firmly believe that financial limitations should not prevent a qualified student from studying abroad. This is why we commit millions of dollars to our study abroad scholarships and aid.

Learn More About Scholarships and Aid

Your Health and Safety Is Our Priority

With more than 75 years of experience, IES Abroad sets the standard for health and safety in study abroad. Our Chicago-based and on-site staff are highly trained in health, safety and crisis management, and a dedicated Crisis Management Team is available 24/7 for emergencies. Your program fee includes international health insurance through CISI, covering physical and mental health needs. 

Read More About Health & Safety Abroad

“I am eternally grateful for my abroad experience and for the IES Abroad staff that helped along the way. Everything was well organized and I felt safe with my program.”

Autumn P. • Lafayette College • Madrid - Engineering, Math & Science

FAQs

IES Abroad is a not-for-profit study abroad provider founded in 1950, with more than 190,000 alumni and partnerships with 275+ U.S. colleges and universities. IES Abroad is committed to delivering the highest quality academics and services, and that is why we are  a recognized member of the Better Business Bureau.

Yes. IES Abroad partners with 275+ U.S. colleges and universities to pre-approve credit transfer, so coursework completed abroad counts directly towards your home university degree.

IES Abroad's program fee covers tuition, housing, health insurance, and a on-site support in one price. IES Abroad also commits nearly $7.9 million in scholarships and financial aid, and the application to find your aid package only takes 10 mins.

Learn more about scholarship & aid 

Our Representatives help you before you apply, our Advisors help you after you apply, and our Center staff help you once you’re on-site. 

Wherever you are and whatever step in the journey you’re at, someone at IES Abroad is there to help you. 

Contact Us

IES Abroad offer 140+ programs across 30+ countries, including semester, summer and year-long study programs, plus international internships (part-time and full- time) with guaranteed placements and academic credits.

According to IES Abroad's alumni survey,  84% of alumni say studying abroad helped them build job skills, and 65% say it led to career advancement and 90% of alumni got their first or second choice in graduate/professional school, with many securing jobs more quickly after graduation. 

See Our Alumni Survey Results 

After we've accepted your application, you’ll gain access to your Predeparture Guide, which provides detailed information about everything you need to know before you go abroad. From visa requirements and academics to local culture and packing information, our Predeparture Guides help make your study abroad transition as seamless as possible.
